text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I heard a sharp voice coming from 
the gym. Peeking inside—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Disciplinary committee, fall in line!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Today's the first day of Enhanced Patrol 
Week. We're gonna crack down on all public 
morals violations across the academy, 
fully loaded!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Let's unite as one and maintain public 
morals! Everyone, head to your posts!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: R-R-RODGER THAAAAT!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"What tremendous drive. I wonder what kind 
of crackdown she's going to enforce...?"

text_block_list.name: Group of Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"So then, there was this super cute dog—" 
"Hey, can I have a bite of that?" "Class 
is seriously such a drag~~"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ahem! Everyone, please do not monopolize 
the tables by spreading out too much!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
""Ah... What's the deal? We're just having 
a fun chat here." "It's a common area, so 
we can use it however we like, right?""

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Precisely because it's a common area! A 
spirit of mutual concession is paramount!!

text_block_list.name: Group of Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Yesss!!" "I'm sorry, I'll use it 
properly...!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Shion-san, a line is starting to form. 
Let's take turns using it!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so sorry! I just couldn't relax until 
I did it, so before I knew it...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Don't forget to keep peace of mind. Please 
be careful from now on!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... Thank you as always for your hard 
work!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno kept up her patrol without 
letting her guard down after that—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oof, looks like they got rejected. Guess 
I'll go cheer 'em up for now.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... I sense someone walking while 
looking at their phone!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Jordan-san, halt right where you are!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hm? What?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"You were just about to use your phone 
while walking, weren't you! No, you can't 
do that! It's forbidden!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aaah... Cut me some slack. I'll reply 
right away, okay?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: "...Gasp! Look out!!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh!? What! Don't pull on me—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (RUUUUMBLE!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Students burst out from around the corner, 
sprinting right past Fenomeno and the 
others!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
HEEEEY! Always pause and look both ways at 
corners, got it?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hold oooooooon!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
T-That scared me~~...! What was that out 
of nowhere!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
That's right! The academy is full of 
dangers! People rushing out into hallways, 
people walking while looking at their 
phones!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's safety awareness is far too 
low. A moment of neglect can lead to a 
lifetime of regret!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...A-All right, fine! Um... I'm sorry, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: —Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Boss. You were watching, then. I am 
truly glad that nothing bad happened, 
sir!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
To protect everyone from the dangers 
lurking within the academy, we must crack 
down even harder!

I hope this raises everyone's safety

If there's anything I can do, I'll help!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it is a difficult matter. Especially 
within the familiar academy grounds, 
students tend to let their guard down.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: That is precisely why we are here.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Now, we shall resume our patrol, yes sir! 
To protect the peace of the academy!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what a gracious offer! With the Boss 
on our side, we'll be unstoppable.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Do not overlook even the slightest 
abnormality. Please, inspect it with a 
critical eye.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Our goal: zero accidents, zero 
violations! Let's do this!!"
